title: Panda wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='11' fill='#3b2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='11' fill='#3b2a4a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='32' fill='#f4f1ea'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#3b2a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#3b2a4a'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#1b6e7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#1b6e7a'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#6fe3d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#6fe3d6'/>
  <!-- glasses frame and bridge -->
  <rect x='21' y='37' width='58' height='4' rx='2' fill='#12a3b5'/>
  <rect x='24' y='36' width='24' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#12a3b5' stroke-width='3'/>
  <rect x='52' y='36' width='24' height='20' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#12a3b5' stroke-width='3'/>
  <rect x='46' y='42' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#12a3b5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3b2a4a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 71 Q50 78 58 71' fill='none' stroke='#3b2a4a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
